subject.title: fix(plugins): honor empty contract plugin scopes

question: Should maintainers land the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103731 as the canonical fix, or merge this shared-resolver PR first and rebase the companion to retain only its unique caller change?
rationale: Both open same-author PRs are correct but overlap on the same source and test changes, so automated review cannot safely choose their landing order and canonical ownership.

options.title: Land the broader companion
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103731 as the complete fix, then close this overlapping PR with credit and provenance.

options.title: Land this PR first
options.body: Merge this narrow shared-resolver fix, then rebase the companion and retain only its document-extractor allowlist change and caller tests.

recommendation.title: Land the broader companion
recommendation.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103731 as the complete fix, then close this overlapping PR with credit and provenance.
